hooks.name: New core module needs a property test
hooks.description: Agent action: when a new module is created in src/engine, src/extract or src/coordinator, ask Kiro to create its property-test file.

action.prompt: A new module was just created in src/engine, src/extract or src/coordinator. If it has non-trivial logic, create or extend tests/test_<module>_properties.py with Hypothesis property tests for every EARS requirement it implements. Follow financial-rules.md or ai-rules.md. Put the requirement ID in a comment above each test. Never call a real LLM or live API in tests; use fixtures in data/fixtures/.
